newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-week bills May 22.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-week bills May 22.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said Friday it will auction $13.75 billion of 52-week bills on May 22 to raise $275 million as $13.487 billion of 52-week bills are maturing.
The bills will be issued May 29 and mature May 28, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944V3.
Amounts issued to Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts will be shown as additions to the offering amount.
Treasury said Fed accounts hold $5.840 billion of the 52-week issue that matures May 29.
